image_description: A grand, ornate Baroque-style pipe organ situated in a church or cathedral setting. The instrument features a symmetrical facade with multiple towers of vertical silver/metallic pipes of varying heights, encased in elaborate gilded woodwork with rococo detailing. A central balcony area contains the console and decorative elements, supported by columns. The background shows high arched ceilings with white plasterwork.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a clear visual hierarchy of pipe heights, creating a stepped profile typical of large pipe organs.
